topic: re-federated identity in OIDC and Sigstore - multi-federation as a privacy lever for transparency-log and artifact-attestation ecosystems

subtopics.scope: The three cloud-identity trust patterns (unfederated, federated, refederated) ordered by trust centralization, and the rule that refederation must explicitly revoke or supersede the old trust rather than just add the new one.
seed_queries: federated vs unfederated identity single sign-on OIDC SAML trust model
identity federation migration revoke old issuer trust chain relying party

subtopics.scope: The concrete relying-party-side changes that constitute OIDC refederation: new issuer URL and JWKS, new client registration, changed claims, changed sub values, updated aud/iss allowlists; plus common triggers: issuer migration, org merge, IdP deprecation, trust revocation.
seed_queries: OpenID Connect issuer change discovery document JWKS rotation relying party
OIDC client registration migration new identity provider claims change sub claim

subtopics.scope: How the Sigstore attestation layer behaves when the OIDC provider changes: Fulcio issues short-lived X.509 certs bound to OIDC identity claims, Rekor logs all certs and signatures, and a new issuer forces trust-list updates and a subject-identity break that needs out-of-band bridging.
seed_queries: Sigstore Fulcio OIDC token short-lived certificate signing identity
Rekor transparency log certificate verification trust root OIDC provider

subtopics.scope: CI and workload OIDC federation: GitHub Actions OIDC tokens, Google Cloud Workload Identity Federation, self-hosted runners such as Tekton, and what changes when the workload signing identity issuer anchor shifts.
seed_queries: GitHub Actions OIDC token workload identity federation keyless signing
Google Cloud Workload Identity Federation OIDC token exchange CI

subtopics.scope: Rekor v2 tile-based transparency log model: sharding that can hold entries from multiple issuers, witness quorum configuration recognizing multiple CA roots, and the Rekor v1 versus v2 difference for cross-issuer attestation.
seed_queries: Rekor v2 tile based transparency log sigstore specification
transparency log sharding witness cosignature multiple log authorities

subtopics.scope: SLSA provenance requirements that break under refederation: invocation configSource.uri consistency, the build identity claim, and what a verifier must accept to treat a refederated builder as a continuation of the same build lineage.
seed_queries: SLSA provenance predicate invocation configSource build definition
SLSA build level requirements builder identity verification attestation

subtopics.scope: The conditional privacy effect of multi-federation: when it helps (different IdPs per RP, no global stable identifier, minimum claims, rotated scoped identifiers) and when it hurts (email reuse across providers, provider correlation of logins, composite attestations).
seed_queries: federated identity privacy multiple identity providers unlinkability correlation
identity federation privacy risks email address cross provider tracking

subtopics.scope: The primitives of the strongest anonymity scheme: pairwise per-audience subject identifiers salted with a user secret, SD-JWT selective disclosure of only the claims an RP needs, and per-transaction claim scoping that defeats replay.
seed_queries: OIDC pairwise subject identifier public subject audience salted
SD-JWT selective disclosure JWT IETF draft oauth claims

subtopics.scope: The privacy-preserving multi-federation trust model as an auditable constraint set: N independent IdPs, one-IdP-per-RP binding, per-RP sub issuance, RP storage of pseudonymous IDs only, plus the MUST, MUST NOT, and NEVER bans on shared identifiers and composite identities.
seed_queries: pseudonymous identifiers trust model design identity providers compromise
selective disclosure verifiable credentials trust framework design constraints

subtopics.scope: Applying pairwise workload identities and per-event short-lived certs to artifact-attestation ecosystems: multiple independent CI sources without a single trust-anchor point of compromise, and unlinkable builders contributing to the same artifact.
seed_queries: sigstore keyless signing multiple CI systems trust root supply chain
supply chain attestation builder identity unlinkability short-lived certificates
